(13 Apr 2005) | longest wins = [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Pet Lua]] (5) 17 Jul - 21 Aug | longest unbeaten = [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Pet Lua]] (11) 03 Jul - 26 Aug | longest winless = | longest losses = | matches = 182 | total goals = 346 | prevseason = [[2004 Girabola|2004]] | nextseason = [[2006 Girabola|2006]] }} The '''2005 [[Girabola]]''' was the 27th season of top-tier football in [[Angola]]. The season ran from 20 February to 23 October 2005. [[Atlético Sport Aviação|ASA]] were the defending champions. The league comprised 14 teams, the bottom three of which were relegated to the 2006 [[Gira Angola]]. [[G.D. Sagrada Esperança|Sagrada Esperança]] were crowned champions, while [[Académica Petróleos do Lobito|Académica do Lobito]], [[Atlético Petróleos do Huambo|Petro do Huambo]] and [[Sporting Clube Petróleos do Bié|Sporting do Bié]] were relegated.{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2005/9/43/Soccer-Sagrada-Esperanca-Win-Girabola-2005,16316552-0ceb-42bc-bf77-aa55a6292bc0.html |title=Soccer: Sagrada Esperança Win Girabola 2005 |publisher=ANGOP.com |date= 24 Oct 2005 |access-date= 8 Dec 2014}} [[Love (footballer)|Arsénio Kabungula]] aka ''Love'' of [[Atlético Sport Aviação|ASA]] finished as the top scorer with 13 goals.{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2007/9/43/Football-Petro-Manucho-Best-Scorer-First-Division-Championship,9682959c-bf08-4c55-86d9-034682bc2f84.html |title=Football: Petro`s Manucho Best Scorer Of First Division Championship |publisher=Federação Angolana de Futebol |date=22 Oct 2007 |access-date=8 Sep 2015 |archive-date=4 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304103801/http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2007/9/43/Football-Petro-Manucho-Best-Scorer-First-Division-Championship,9682959c-bf08-4c55-86d9-034682bc2f84.html |url-status=dead }} ==Changes from the 2004 season== '''Relegated:''' [[Académica Petróleo Kwanda Soyo|Académica do Soyo]], [[S.L.
